intro: First shift? Welcome behind the counter. This machine might look intimidating, but we'll take it one step at a time.
I know how to drink coffee. Making it is a different story.
Good. That means you're ready to learn. Here comes our first customer.
Hi! One double espresso, please. I have a class in twenty minutes.
Weigh the coffee first, then we'll check the grinder. Someone left it on a coarse setting.
Your turn to lead. Tap Hint if you get stuck.
Double espresso, but make it kaw. Stronger, shorter shot.
Kaw means a stronger cup. Same dose, but stop the shot earlier, around 30 g. You've got this.

reactions.Perfect Brew: Wow. This is exactly how I like it!
